reason: The cited passages support that CoNiGe alloying stabilizes the Ni2In structure, lowers Tm, and enables magnetostructural coupling for a large MCE (E2, E3, E4). However, none of the cited evidence mentions mechanical performance or provides any data on how CoNiGe alloying affects it, leaving a key premise entirely unsupported.
premises: MnNiSi and CoNiGe are isostructural (both can adopt Ni2In-type hexagonal structure)
Alloying MnNiSi with CoNiGe stabilizes the Ni2In structure and lowers the structural transition temperature Tm
Lowering Tm into the Curie temperature window (CTW) enables magnetostructural coupling and a large magnetocaloric effect
The cited evidence addresses mechanical performance improvement from CoNiGe alloying
